entities.name: EPS network feature support
entities.description: Information element used by the network to inform the UE about supported features. When not included, UE interprets it as all bits zero except for S1-u data transfer bit.

entities.name: S1-u data transfer
entities.description: Network feature indicating support for S1-u data transfer. When EPS network feature support IE is absent, UE assumes this feature is supported.

entities.name: EPS network feature support IE absent
entities.description: Condition when the EPS network feature support IE is not included in the message from network to UE.

relations.description: When EPS network feature support IE is absent, UE establishes that S1-u data transfer feature is supported.
EPS network feature support IE guards the S1-u data transfer feature support indication through its bit encoding.
